reason: Qwen authored development showed correct change routing can still retain an already-wrong cached decision. Refinement chosen after those 24 outputs and before new-source full text or predictions.
audited_change_map: Use the same map gate; additionally refresh a semantically not-established cache and a fixed SHA-256 modulo-4 partition of claim IDs. No reference labels enter routing. No audit rate sweep.
hash_audit: A low-cost control refreshes only invalid caches and the same modulo-4 partition, with no model gate or change map.
retrieval: Fixed 500-character chunks, stride 400, within each normalized PDF page; per-version character 2-to-4-gram TF-IDF cosine retrieval, top 3 chunks. Fit on that version's entire PDF only; claim is the only query. All pages including forms enter the pool. Reference annotations are not used.
retrieval_scoring: Report end-to-end decisions against full-source provisional references and separately report supplied-reference coverage. Missing retrieved evidence can make a cautious not-established response appropriate to its input but incomplete for the full-document task. Do not call all such errors reasoning errors.
comparison_scope: The curated condition controls reading and update routing. The full-document retrieval condition adds extraction/retrieval failures and creates one map per claim-specific retrieved bundle. Neither is independent human evaluation.
new_source_rule: Do not replace selected new documents after viewing model predictions. Record inaccessible originals and distinguish original/revised source provenance from a current overwritten attachment.
